profile.name: DHRUV DESAI
profile.title: Supply Chain Analyst · Demand & Supply Planning
profile.bio: Supply Chain Analyst with 4+ years of experience supporting demand planning, supply planning, inventory management, procurement, S&OP, MRP, forecasting, and supply chain analytics across consumer goods, retail pharmacy, and technology-services environments. Experienced with SAP MM, SAP APO, SAP SCM, Oracle NetSuite, SQL, Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Tableau, and Python for analyzing supply chain data, improving planning visibility, and supporting operational decisions. Strong background in inventory optimization, safety stock planning, supplier performance, purchase order analysis, procurement analytics, KPI reporting, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
